intro: Which Wich is the customizable sandwich chain famous for its ordering system: you grab a paper bag, mark your toppings with a Sharpie, and the kitchen builds your 'wich' to order. The menu is organized by category (turkey, Italian, classics, veggie and more), led by the loaded Wicked. Sandwiches come in three sizes and can be made into a bowlwich or a wrap. Below is the full Which Wich menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Which Wich, the loaded Wicked is about $13.20 and the Thank You Turkey about $11.10 (delivery-menu prices; in-store is often lower). Sandwiches come in 7-inch, 10.5-inch and 14-inch sizes, so the price rises with size. Fries are $5.10 and a cookie $2.70. The mark-your-bag ordering and the Wicked are the signatures. Prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Which Wich value: the smallest 7-inch size and the classic single-meat wiches are the cheapest way in, and a cookie ($2.70) is the classic add-on. The app and Which Wich rewards drop a birthday reward and deals. In-store prices run lower than the delivery menu, so order in-store or for pickup to save. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a sandwich at Which Wich?
faqs.a: The loaded Wicked is about $13.20 and the Thank You Turkey about $11.10 on the delivery menu (in-store is often lower). Sandwiches come in 7-inch, 10.5-inch and 14-inch sizes, so the price rises with size. Fries are $5.10. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How does ordering at Which Wich work?
faqs.a: Which Wich is known for its ordering system: you grab a pre-printed paper bag for the sandwich category you want, use a Sharpie to mark your bread, meats, cheeses and toppings, and drop it in the bin. The kitchen builds your 'wich' exactly as marked.

faqs.q: What is the Wicked at Which Wich?
faqs.a: The Wicked is Which Wich's loaded signature: five meats (ham, turkey, roast beef, bacon and more) with three cheeses and all the toppings. It is the heftiest, most popular wich, about $13.20 for a medium. Prices vary by location.

Which Wich sandwiches are fully customizable, so calories vary a lot and are not reproduced here rather than guessed. The chain publishes some nutrition and a build-your-own nutrition tool online for exact figures.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Which Wich?
faqs.a: Favorites include the Wicked, the Thank You Turkey, the Classic Italian, the buffalo chicken wich, and Courtney's Cookie.
